en.title: Indigo Remnants
en.premise: At 3:12 AM, in a second-hand bookstore tucked away in a corner of the sleepless city, a man is found dead. The victim is a powerful businessman with deep political ties, and left at the scene is an antique book with inexplicably missing pages. Detective Kuse of the First Investigation Division begins a meticulous hunt for the truth, even as he senses the cold hand of an organizational cover-up. Between the city's roar and its silence, a buried past is about to be unearthed.

zh.title: 蓝色的残滓
zh.premise: 凌晨3点12分，在不夜城角落的一家旧书店中，一名男子被发现死在原地。死者是一位在政界拥有深厚影响力的实业家，而现场唯一留下的线索，是一本页码莫名“缺失”的古书。搜查一课的刑警久濑在察觉到组织试图掩盖真相的同时，开始了缜密的走访与证据搜集。在城市的喧嚣与静谧之间，一段被掩埋的过去即将被揭开。
